answer_1.quote: In-context prompting is an efficient approach for communicating LLMs but the performance is strongly affected by the design of the prompt in specifized tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates natural language prompts for downstream tasks, including few-shot and zero-shot prompts with or without chain-of-thought (COT) examples, optimized via the SEE framework.

answer_2.quote: the LLM L produces the corresponding output A via prompting with the concatenation of prompt P and a given input Q, i.e., [P; Q]. The objective of prompt optimization is to design the best natural language prompt P * that maximizes the performance of L on T
